name: Warp
summary: Agentic development environment built around the terminal.
description: Warp is a modern terminal and agentic development environment where developers run AI coding agents with the model of their choice, alongside classic command-line work. It positions itself as a 'software factory' with agent evals and automation. A free plan is available, and paid plans add more AI requests and team features.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: A free plan is available, and paid plans add more AI requests and team features.
